Hey #edu407Fall19 I wanted to share some examples of some digital texts:

I like the comic as a way to show how multimodal text can get a #socialjustice issue across. Notice the balance of images and words

https://twitter.com/jupiter_pop/status/1179458039704932353

Here is a wanted poster. You can make digital wanted posters for book characters. The key is to have a pedagogical goal beyond learning to compost multimodal texts

Here is a movie poster you can remix about characters or historical figures

How about a Star Wars Crawler?

Maybe a Fake Facebook Page

In fact if you want HTML and CSS I have a ton of stuff

You can use PPT to make an extended multimedia metaphor poem

You could learn to make a gif

You can record a poem

Make an infographic

Write a digital essay
